authority: optional audification/sonification and relational research metadata only; not doctrine, historical Hebrew-letter music attribution, empirical spiritual physics, recognition, readiness, identity, governance, authority, or MANA policy
purpose: Test whether music-theory structures can make Tree, letter-wheel, Tempus, and Vitae relationships perceptible through sound while preserving the rule that musical projection consumes semantic registries and never creates their meaning.

music_theory_reference: Twelve-tone equal-tempered pitch-class space may be represented modulo 12.
A perfect fifth spans seven semitones in 12-TET; repeatedly adding 7 modulo 12 visits all twelve pitch classes before returning.
A just perfect fifth is the frequency ratio 3:2.
Twelve pure 3:2 fifths do not equal seven exact octaves; their mismatch is the Pythagorean comma.

circle_of_fifths.posture: relational ordering operator; not a zodiac or Hebrew-letter attribution by itself

just_fifth.architectural_observation: an acoustically pure fifth-cycle does not close perfectly; exact circular closure is a tuning/projection choice

vitae_spiral_bridge.observation: Vitae already models each grade as one 360-position turn and ten grades as a helix.
vitae_spiral_bridge.music_analogy: A harmonic cycle may return to an equivalent pitch class while register, tuning, voicing, timbre, context, and accumulated history differ.
vitae_spiral_bridge.candidate_law: Harmonic Return Is Not Identity — returning to a named pitch class or curriculum angle does not mean returning to the same lived state.
vitae_spiral_bridge.closure_caution: The Pythagorean comma is a useful factual example that apparent circular closure can depend on the chosen tuning model; it is not evidence of metaphysical ascent.

tempus_bridge.allowed_experiment: a participant may select a reversible sonification scheme for temporal regions, but Tempus meaning remains owned by Tempus and the sound mapping remains projection metadata

candidate_laws: Resonance Is Relation, Not Frequency — the primary musical object is a relation among sounds, not an intrinsic sacred number assigned to a person or symbol.
Sonification Is Projection, Not Ontology — sound may reveal or teach a relationship but does not become the authority that defines it.
Harmonic Return Is Not Identity — recurrence may preserve a class while context and history change.
Closure May Be a Projection — a circle can be exact in one representational system while the underlying ratio process forms a near-return or spiral.
Count Match Is Not Correspondence — 3, 7, 12, or 5 may justify an experiment but not a historical or causal claim.
Dissonance Is Information, Not Failure — acoustic tension may be rendered without moralizing it or treating it as participant deficiency.
